title: fix(service-settings): Settings help in business words; Country is a picker that shows names and stores the code
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHDem82MKCs3q2zQkEAkpqZ)_

Fixes #27853
Fixes #27867

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:设置页(认证、功能开关、邮件)的帮助文字改成业务用语,不再出现环境变量名、选项键、错误码、对象 API 名或代码调用;继承值徽标从「租户」改为「组织」;Webhooks 副标题改写;公司「国家」与本地化「默认国家」改为显示国名、存储代码的选择器。四个语言包同步。
- **为什么改**:管理员在 Setup → Settings 看到的是像代码注释的说明(`invite_only`、`OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`、`defineWebhook()`),国家要手打两位大写代码,输入「de」或「Germany」都被拒且没有提示。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改文字与国家字段的控件类型;国家仍以 `iso_3166_alpha2` 值域校验,接受的值集合不变(`DE` 照收,`de`、`ZZ` 照拒)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/company.manifest.ts`(国家选项从共享的 249 个代码生成);`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts`(帮助改写);`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts`(形状钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts src/manifests/country-picker.pin.test.ts`,预期全绿;或打开 Setup → Company,在「国家」输入 Germ,列表出现「Germany (DE)」,选中后保存为 DE。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**#27853 — Settings help in business words.** Every string an administrator is shown for Authentication, Feature Flags and Mail (the manifest literals, which are the English fallback, and the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES packs) now names the effect instead of the machine value:

- Self-registration audience: the help says Invitation only / Allowlisted email domains / Open (the labels the page shows), not the stored option keys. The email-verification override, the Google client ID and secret, and the reverse-proxy trust switch are described as "set in the server configuration" instead of by env var name or stack-config path. The API-key help no longer quotes error codes; the permission-set help no longer quotes permission-set API names.
- Feature Flags beta banner: no env var, no code span.
- Mail: the durable-queue help no longer names the queue object. The Send-test-email result for a log-only provider (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts`, the two message strings only) says "kept in the email log" instead of naming the mail object.
- The inherited-value badge (`settingsCommon.sourceLabels.tenant`) reads Organization / 组织 / 組織 / Organización.
- The Webhooks subtitle (`sys_webhook` description, `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts`) says what a webhook is without the code calls or the internal component names; the code-level account stays in the comment beside it. The en bundle is regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES values are hand-translated leaves.

The technical detail the help used to inline is already in the deployment docs (`content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` names the email-verification override). The settings manifest has no per-field docs-link slot, so the help now carries no technical detail rather than a link.

**#27867 — Country pickers.** Company → Country and Localization → Default country change from `text` to `select`. Their `options` are every member of the `iso_3166_alpha2` value domain, generated from the shared `ISO_3166_ALPHA2_CODES` (`@objectstack/spec/shared`) with names from `Intl.DisplayNames`, never a hand-kept list; each locale pack names the same 249 codes in its own language through `countryOptionLabels(locale)`. The `valueDomain` declaration stays, so it remains the enforcement boundary and the accepted set is unchanged. The console renders a domain-bearing `select` as its suggest-and-pick combobox: typing a name lists the named options, and picking one stores the code. `pattern` / `minLength` / `maxLength` stay on the specifier, so the server's verdict for every value is the same as before.

**Premise correction for #27867.** Company has no Locale or Timezone setting; it has only Country. Locale and Timezone live on Localization, where `locale` is already a closed picker with language names and `timezone` is the suggest-any-IANA-zone combobox with named suggestions, so neither changes here. Localization's `default_country` had the same two-letter free-text shape as Company's country and gets the same picker (file surface amended on the claim).

## Tests

- `src/settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts` (new): for auth, feature_flags and mail, the manifest literals and every shipped pack carry no env var or error code, enum key or object API name, camelCase code identifier, code call or code span; a teeth case proves each shape catches the string it was written for. Every pack's tenant source label is not "tenant" in any of the four languages.
- `src/manifests/country-picker.pin.test.ts` (new): both keys are `select` with `valueDomain: 'iso_3166_alpha2'` after the spec parse; their options equal the 249 domain codes, each named with its code; a stored `DE` round-trips through `SettingsService` and is one of the options; `ZZ` and `de` are still refused with `value_domain` and `Germany` is still refused; each pack names all 249 codes.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.description.pin.test.ts` (new): the source description and the four bundles carry no code call, camelCase identifier, object API name or internal component name.
- `src/manifests/auth.manifest.test.ts`: the two pins that held the old wording now hold the business wording (the sign-up help names each posture by its label and spells no key; the Google help names the server configuration and no env var).

## Acceptance notes

- The console shows a stored country code (`DE`) in the combobox text box, with the named options in its list. Showing the stored code as its name inside the box is a `ui/` change to `DomainCombobox` (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`), outside this PR's file surface; reported to the seat for a follow-up card.
- The console's own fallback for the source badge (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/useSettingsLabel.ts`, used only when no server bundle loads) still reads "Tenant"; outside this file surface.
- AI & Embedder help still names env vars and `sys_ai_trace` (parent row 2 lists it); not in this card's three namespaces; reported to the seat.
